data.description:
Unreal fitness. Real results. The most fun you can have working out is here. Start your subscription with a free 14-day trial now. 

🔥Experience the power of immersive fitness with expert coaches, heart-pounding workouts in stunning 360 environments, and music from the world’s biggest artists.

🌎 Work out, Stretch, and Meditate your way around the world with thousands of personalized session recommendations and new workouts added every week.

🏡 Transform any space into a world-class fitness center with Mixed Reality workouts that let you smash your fitness goals (without smashing your room).

🤜🤛 Push your fitness to new heights with real connections on Supernatural Together. Start a room to invite your friends or join a Quick Play anytime for Team Workouts with other Athletes from the Supernatural Community. 

🙌 Keep the connection going in our bustling Supernatural Official Facebook Group where our community shares fitness goals, workout recs, and plenty of motivation.

Ready to see where Supernatural takes you?

Start your free 14-day trial to kick off your subscription today, cancel anytime. Available on Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest 3, Meta Quest 3s, and Meta Quest Pro.

Supernatural has officially launched  our mutli-player experience - introducing Supernatural Together. 

Supernatural Together lets you work out in real-time with friends and other Athletes, smashing goals, growing your Supernatural community, and pushing your workouts to the next level — together. Invite up to two friends by creating a Team Name, or get automatically teamed up with other Athletes by hopping into a Quick Play. All Team Workouts are collaborative through our new Challenge Zones, compatible across individual skill levels, and you will be able to communicate with your teammates through voice chat and interactions such as clapping and high fives!

Need help, or have a suggestion? Reach out to us at support@getsupernatural.com

Some members who are not on the latest Meta Quest OS are experiencing issues opening Supernatural.

Please ensure you're on the latest Meta Quest OS before opening the app. Here's how to ensure you're updated:
1 - Go to Settings from the main menu of your Quest
2 - Select "System Settings" from the Settings menu
3 - Select "Software Update" from the left hand side
